title: Opening a store already at the target schema version is a no-op that emits no migrated event
description: When the on-disk schema version equals the build's max known migration version, the migration runner applies no migrations and returns a result whose applied-versions array is empty. The store facade emits the opened event as usual but does NOT emit a migrated event on this path. Consumers that key off the migrated event to fire post-migration bookkeeping do not fire spuriously on a routine boot.
rationale: A store that emits a migrated event on every boot destroys the signal that migration-adjacent bookkeeping (cache warmup, index rebuild, replica reseeding) needs to fire. Idempotent open is what makes routine boots cheap and rare boots observable; conflating them costs both signals.
